messages:
sales-amy: Heads up — during the Contoso demo the POC hit repeated 5xx and a lot of 429s. They paused the test and asked if this is expected under burst. sample errors: `2026-03-20T15:11:02Z req=abc123 503 backend overload`, `2026-03-20T15:11:05Z req=abc124 429 rate_limit`. They want an explanation before next meeting with execs.
eli (eng-runtime): Thanks Amy. Can you paste the full request IDs for a few of the 5xx events? Also which model and region were they hitting?
sales-amy: model=redwood-large-v1, region=us-west-2, req ids: abc123, abc126, abc129. They were running a scripted demo with ~60 concurrent sessions and some long prompt prefixes.
maya (sre): Noted. That concurrency for reserved POC should be fine but if autoscale didn't spin up fast enough we hit the burstpool and then the request queue overflows — leads to 503s. 429s mean we hit rate limits at the front proxy too. Will check autoscaler logs.
samir (eng-infra): Pulling node metrics now. Preliminary: GPU pool reached 100% allocation at 15:10:40, autoscale request issued at 15:10:42, new nodes ready at 15:12:08 — ~86s startup. Prefetch/burst pool filled and started shed at 15:11:00.
judy (support): Customer reporting demo saw ~5 minute lag recovery overall because they retried manually. They asked if we can guarantee failover to smaller model or fallback queue while scale completes.
eli (eng-runtime): We have a failback policy but current POC config set failover=false to ensure deterministic latency profiles. If we toggle to allow failover to redwood-small-v1 we can keep responses but quality might drop. Suggest temporary toggle for the demo.
sales-amy: Can we do that on the fly for this customer? They'll accept slight quality reduction if demo stays live.
maya (sre): Quick mitigation steps:
- Enable model fallback policy for that project
- Temporarily bump burstpool_size to +2 instances for the POC (if quota allows)
- Reduce front-proxy rate-limit window for that key
I can apply the first two within 10 min if infra approves.
samir (eng-infra): Quota check: we have two spare GPUs in us-west-2 reserved for burst; I'll allocate them but need a deploy window. ETA 8 minutes to open capacity.
eli (eng-runtime): Also recommend lowering autoscale cooldown from 120s -> 30s for this POC to let it react faster. Note: may cause more churn but acceptable for POC.
sales-amy: go for it. Tell me when done so I can restart demo with Contoso.
judy (support): I'll coordinate and provide a short script for them to restart clients gently (backoff + jitter) to avoid thundering herd.
sre-bot: [alert] AutoscalerEvent: scale_request id=sr-778 ts=2026-03-20T15:10:42Z target=+2 nodes state=issued
sre-bot: [alert] NodeProvision: node n-0912 status=provisioning ts=2026-03-20T15:11:10Z
samir (eng-infra): Allocated the 2 GPUs, burstpool increased. Provisioning finished at 15:18:20 (had a kube image pull delay). Sorry — longer than expected.
eli (eng-runtime): I toggled model fallback for the project at 15:18:45. Also lowered cooldown to 30s. Configs:
```
service.project.contoso.fallback.enabled=true
service.project.contoso.autoscale.cooldown=30
service.project.contoso.burstpool.size+=2
```
maya (sre): I also decreased front-proxy rate-limit for the API key to 200rps per key from 500rps until demo ends.
sales-amy: Contoso restarted at 15:19:10 and reported no 503s after that, just a few slower responses while scale finished. They accepted the fallback to small model for ~10 of the longest requests.
judy (support): I'll file a follow-up ticket with the customer summarizing the mitigations and ask if they want us to keep the temporary settings for the remainder of the POC. Also will include cost note: extra GPUs add ~$0.XX/hr — confirm exact pricing.
samir (eng-infra): Cost: burst GPUs used ~8.5 minutes provisioning + 10 min active -> billable ~19min total. Rough estimate $0.45 for the window, will reconcile with billing.
security-bot: Reminder: toggling fallback is fine but ensure no sensitive data flows to smaller model if policy forbids. Contoso POC uses internal docs — confirm redaction policy.
eli (eng-runtime): Good point. We flagged sensitive mode for this project off, data stayed in private pool. Confirmed no external model variants were used.
sales-amy: Thanks everyone — Contoso wants a short postmortem to share with their infra lead before continuing. Can we draft one? Include root cause: autoscale startup latency + front-proxy rate limit + no fallback.
maya (sre): I'll draft a 1-paragraph postmortem and send to this thread + to sales-amy for review. Action items: increase POC burstpool by default for scheduled demos, add optional pre-warm API to reduce startup time, document recommended autoscale cooldown for POCs.
judy (support): Adding ticket: #POC-4332 summary + actions and cost estimate to customer.
sales-amy: Perfect. Contoso rescheduled demo for tomorrow 10:00 PT — I'll request watchers. Closing for now, will reopen if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
